# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。
- 原始输出一律写入仓库并推送，不留在临时目录；data-auditor 须提交 audit 脚本的完整 stdout。（出处：Review Gate 第 4 轮裁决，Owner 批准，永久）

## 10. 信任状态

- `code-reviewer`:已验证（2026-11-21 盲测 3/3 检出、0 误报；每类仅 1 个样本，PASS 仍须附原始输出）。
- `data-auditor`:「待验证」。2026-11-21 的盲测只测了 code-reviewer;埋入已知 bug 的检出率测试通过前,其 PASS 仅作参考。
- 以上两条的出处：Review Gate 第 5 轮裁决。（出处：Review Gate 第 6 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

_host.description: Optional. Name of an attached machine to run this tool call on; omit it to run in this session's own environment (the default). Use only a name this session listed as attached; the result says where it ran. Choose per call by which machine the command or file path concerns; the attached-machines note says what lives where and which are reachable now.

tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

# Mythos 项目宪章 v2.0(2026-11-08)

**本文件取代宪章 v1.0。** 与 v1.0、旧 checkpoint 或旧 PROTOCOL 文件冲突时,以本文件和 `research/mini_mythos/PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 为准。历史文件保留不改,但不再约束新工作。

## 1. 方向

- 底座是 Parcae-140M 预训练权重(`SandyResearch/parcae-140m@236739ce`)。我们不再从随机初始化训练自己的权重。
- 最终的 Mythos 是 **Parcae 的派生模型**(Parcae 权重 + 我们的机制/适配器),不是独立权重。Parcae 权重和分词器的许可证未确认,确认前不对外分发任何权重或派生模型。
- 目标:用实验证明“Parcae + 机制”优于原生 Parcae,即同等计算下质量更高,或相近质量下计算更少。不宣称复刻 Claude Mythos。

## 2. 分工与关闭

| 角色 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| 项目负责人 | 定方向、定预算、批准进入下一阶段、宣布 CLOSED |
| Claude Project(策略) | 设计和审核实验方案、解读结果 |
| Claude Code(执行) | 写代码、测试、运行、提交结果和 checkpoint |

不再要求 ChatGPT 或 Grok 交叉审核。阶段由负责人在看过结果后宣布 CLOSED。

## 3. 每个实验的最低要求

1. 一页方案,写在实验目录的 `README.md`:目的、数据、对照、主指标、通过标准、算力和时间上限、停止条件。
2. 方案提交后再运行;看到结果后不改通过标准。
3. 状态如实标注:PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED。负结果也是结果。
4. **同预算对照**:可训练参数量相同、训练 token 数相同、学习率等超参搜索次数相同。只有优于这个对照,才算机制有效。
5. **新数据**:主结论必须来自训练和调参都没用过的数据,至少包含一个异领域集;并抽样检查它与预训练语料的 n-gram 重叠。
6. 每次只加一个机制;组合要等单项都在新数据上通过。
7. 评测输入与预训练一致:**不加 BOS/EOS**,窗口从文档开头取。Parcae 预训练(`pqds-pure` + best-fit 打包)不加任何特殊 token,实测加 BOS 会明显变差(见 `research/mini_mythos/stage0/STAGE0_REVIEW.md`)。BOS 只作对照。

## 4. 流程要轻

- 证据保留到“别人能复核”为止:代码 commit、配置、数据锁定文件(版本 + sha256)、随机种子、汇总结果、每样本结果。大文件留在运行机器上,不进 Git。
- 不对历史文件做逐个哈希保护;不为每个实验重写启动器和守卫。
- 允许中断后续跑,只要配置不变且如实记录。修了 bug 可以重跑,但要在 checkpoint 里写明原因和前后差异。
- 路径或导入类问题 30 分钟内修不好,就停下报告;算力超过方案上限,就停下报告进度。
- checkpoint 一页以内:做了什么、结果、commit SHA、未解决问题、下一步。

## 5. 不要做

- 不修改上游 Parcae(`sandyresearch/parcae@69284c13`,只读)。
- 不操作 PR #24(D1 Draft,保留不合并)。
- 不把开发集上的收益写成“机制有效”。
- 不在方案外使用 GPU;GPU 租用由负责人批准。

## 6. Metrix 子项目(2026-11-13 负责人决定)

Metrix 是独立子项目,不属于 Mythos 方向。`metrix/` 下的工作以 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 为准:

- 本宪章第 1 节(Parcae 底座、派生模型目标)和第 3.7 节(不加 BOS/EOS)**不适用于 Metrix**。Metrix 使用 Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B,打分按其 chat template 构造输入。
- 第 5 节「不要做」的各条继续适用于 Metrix。
- 其余条款与 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 冲突时,在 `metrix/` 内以 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 为准。

@metrix/CLAUDE.md

# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

7	every checkpoint and shows the hash unchanged). Review Gate's ruling of 2026-11-27 (tasks/IMPL_C2_OWNER_MESSAGE.md): item
8	1 (TEST evaluation calls do not fetch; begin and finish do; nobody pushes to the pilot's branch between them).

10	Commands (run_pilot.py; every command prints RESULT: PASS / RESULT: FAIL, exit 0 only on PASS):
11	  smoke          steps 1-7 on the CPU with a random small model of the protocol's class (the pinned config.json
12	                 with fewer layers and a smaller width; no weight file is downloaded or loaded), STEPS optimizer steps
13	                 per training run, then step 8 only as the refusal of the TEST generator. Nothing is committed; every
14	                 output carries SMOKE_LABEL (JSON: its "label" field; checkpoints: their "label" entry; data files,
15	                 which must stay byte-identical to the frozen hashes: the LABEL.txt of their directory); records go to
16	                 <work>/records, which record.write_record refuses to be the formal results directory. Gate 0 is
17	                 computed and its status fixed to NOT_TESTED; the stops that read result values (SMOKE_RECORDED_STOPS)
18	                 are recorded as "would stop" and the run continues, all other stops stop it.
19	  formal         steps 1-7 on the A100, and when Gate 0 is PASS the freeze record of step 8. Every step commits and
20	                 pushes its record (testgate.commit_paths: the pilot's checkout at the remote branch's latest commit).
21	                 The contract's step count only: RunMode refuses a shortened count in formal mode, and the formal
22	                 command has no step option.
23	  test-generate  step 8, TEST generation: python -m metrix_e1.test_data as a subprocess (it checks the generator's
24	                 preconditions, writes test_qa.jsonl and general_test.jsonl to <work>/test, runs the TEST part of the
25	                 leakage checks and commits the ST10 record). The data-auditor's L6 count follows outside this file.
26	  test-evaluate  step 8, TEST evaluated once: testgate.begin_test_evaluation, N and the 15 checkpoints of the
27	                 marker through evaluate.evaluate_model(split="test"), T1-T3, testgate.finish_test_evaluation.
28	  fetch-model    the pinned model revision's files (weights included) into <inputs>/qwen_model, on the A100 host only.
29	
30	Directories. <work> (outside the repository; refused inside it) holds the data files, the checkpoints, the device
31	ledger and the GPU clock (formal), the TEST files and the per-question TEST details (outside the repository: no TEST
32	content is committed). Formal records go to the repository's results directory (record.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL): one record
33	per step, one per training run (with the DEV summary), the per-question DEV details, the Gate 0 and freeze records, and
34	the experiment record of protocol section 10 (one file per command run, named with its start time) at the end of the
35	commands formal, test-evaluate and, for an ST10 stop, test-generate; stopped runs included. A stop inside a step first
36	writes that step's record; records written but not yet committed when a run stops are committed with its experiment
37	record. One exception (final_record): a formal run that stops before step 1 began writes its experiment record to
38	<work> only.
39	
40	Continuity (start_checks). A formal pilot is one sequence of commands on one machine with one --work: once a formal
41	run has committed step records, formal and test-evaluate refuse a --work without the device ledger (the recorded device
42	name, ST9, and the GPU clock, ST7, live there), and formal refuses to run again once a freeze record is committed. How
43	a stopped pilot is restarted is the Owner's decision (RUNBOOK_A100.md).
44	
45	Checkpoints (protocol section 7: only the final checkpoint of a run is kept and evaluated). Each run's final state is
46	hashed (train.state_sha256, interpretation B25), saved with torch.save, reloaded into a fresh model of the run's
47	structure and hashed again; the two hashes must be equal, and the reloaded model is the one evaluated, so every
48	evaluation reads the saved checkpoint. All 30 are kept (none is deleted: metrix/CLAUDE.md section 7); the RUNBOOK
49	gives the disk size.
50	
51	Preflight (section 8 step 2, ST11; interpretation B17). ST11 reads B17's estimate (compute.estimate_total_hours)
52	unchanged. The preflight also measures one model load, one state_sha256, one checkpoint save, one reload and one file
53	hash of the first configuration's model (DEFERRED_MINORS 1.27 CA21) and reports, beside B17's estimate,
54	  CHECKPOINT_OVERHEAD = loads x load + runs x (2 hashes + save + reload + file hash)
55	                        + TEST state hashes x hash + TEST checkpoint files x file hash
56	(evaluation_plan: loads of N, the 30 runs, the G0.8 re-evaluations and the 16 TEST models; the TEST models' state
57	hashes in testgate.require_test_session plus N's in begin; the 15 TEST checkpoint files) and the sum; whether ST11
58	should read the sum is for Review Gate (reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md). The measured times also give the ST7 look-ahead
59	(next_seconds): before a training run its training, save and DEV evaluation; before an evaluation the evaluation; before
60	the TEST evaluation begins, the whole TEST evaluation (test_evaluation_seconds), so that ST7 does not stop it half-way.

104	def plain(obj):
105	    """JSON-ready copy: exact fractions as floats, tuples and sets as lists, dataclasses as dicts."""
106	    if isinstance(obj, Fraction):
107	        return float(obj)
108	    if isinstance(obj, dict):
109	        return {str(k): plain(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
110	    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
111	        return [plain(v) for v in obj]
112	    if isinstance(obj, (set, frozenset)):
113	        return sorted(plain(v) for v in obj)
114	    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(obj) and not isinstance(obj, type):
115	        return plain(dataclasses.asdict(obj))
116	    if isinstance(obj, Path):
117	        return str(obj)
118	    return obj

146	def step1_manifests(fz, current, file_hashes):
147	    """Section 8 step 1: the two manifests with the field step 1 writes filled in (frozen.STEP1_FIELDS; ST12 leaves
148	    exactly these out). DATA_MANIFEST.json files.<name> of the 8 non-TEST files: status GENERATED, byte_sha256,
149	    canonical_sha256; SPLIT_MANIFEST.json split_sha256.<name> of the non-TEST split files: canonical_sha256
150	    (interpretation B3's ruling note: the canonical hash of train_Y.jsonl among them). TEST entries stay as they are.
151	    `current`: {repository path: bytes} of the two manifests as in the working tree. Returns {path: new bytes};
152	    raises ST12Error when anything outside the step-1 field would change."""
153	    dm = json.loads(current[FZ.DATA_MANIFEST_REL])
154	    sm = json.loads(current[FZ.SPLIT_MANIFEST_REL])
155	    for name in D.DATA_FILES:
156	        dm["files"][name].update(status=GENERATED, byte_sha256=file_hashes[name]["byte_sha256"],
157	                                 canonical_sha256=file_hashes[name]["canonical_sha256"])
158	    for name in sm["split_sha256"]:
159	        if name in D.DATA_FILES:
160	            sm["split_sha256"][name] = file_hashes[name]["canonical_sha256"]
161	    out = {FZ.DATA_MANIFEST_REL: manifest_bytes(dm), FZ.SPLIT_MANIFEST_REL: manifest_bytes(sm)}
162	    for rel, blob in out.items():
163	        if FZ.strip_step1_fields(rel, json.loads(blob)) != FZ.strip_step1_fields(rel, json.loads(fz.blobs[rel])):
164	            raise ST12Error("%s: step 1 would change it outside %r" % (rel, FZ.STEP1_FIELDS[rel]))
165	    return out

168	def evaluation_plan(contract):
169	    """Counts of the checkpoint overhead: model loads (N, the 30 runs, one G0.8 re-evaluation per training seed, N and
170	    the 15 TEST checkpoints), checkpoints saved (30), state hashes at TEST (the 16 models in require_test_session and
171	    N's once more in begin), TEST checkpoint files hashed before the marker (15)."""
172	    seeds = len(contract.training.training_seeds)
173	    runs = contract.arms.counts["total_training_runs"]
174	    test_models = 1 + len(T.ARMS_TRAINED) * seeds
175	    return {"loads": 1 + runs + seeds + test_models, "checkpoints": runs, "test_state_hashes": test_models + 1,
176	            "test_file_hashes": test_models - 1, "test_models": test_models}
177	
178	
179	def checkpoint_overhead_seconds(contract, load_s, hash_s, save_s, reload_s, file_hash_s):
180	    n = evaluation_plan(contract)
181	    return (n["loads"] * load_s + n["checkpoints"] * (2 * hash_s + save_s + reload_s + file_hash_s)
182	            + n["test_state_hashes"] * hash_s + n["test_file_hashes"] * file_hash_s), n
183	
184	
185	def test_evaluation_seconds(contract, pre):
186	    """ST7 look-ahead before the TEST evaluation begins: N loaded (load_s) and the 15 checkpoints loaded
187	    (load_checkpoint: reload_s), the state hashes (N twice), the 15 checkpoint files hashed, each model evaluated once
188	    on TEST (a DEV evaluation scaled by test / dev questions per fact, as B17). No margin is added (for Review Gate,
189	    reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md). `pre`: the timing block of the committed step 2 record."""
190	    n = evaluation_plan(contract)
191	    acc = contract.accounting
192	    per_eval = pre["dev_evaluation_seconds"] * acc.test_questions_per_fact / acc.dev_questions_per_fact
193	    return (pre["load_s"] + n["test_file_hashes"] * pre["reload_s"] + n["test_models"] * per_eval
194	            + n["test_state_hashes"] * pre["hash_s"] + n["test_file_hashes"] * pre["file_hash_s"])

248	    def write(self, name, obj):
249	        """A JSON record of this command under the records directory with its mode and label; the formal results
250	        directory refuses smoke and preflight records and a formal record goes nowhere else (record.write_record; the
251	        one exception is the experiment record of a formal run that stopped before step 1, final_record)."""
252	        rec = dict(plain(obj), mode=self.mode.name, label=self.mode.label)
253	        path = R.write_record(rec, self.records / name, self.root)

259	    def rel(self, path):
260	        return Path(path).resolve().relative_to(self.root).as_posix()

262	    def commit(self, paths, message, what):
263	        """Formal: commit those of `paths` whose bytes differ from HEAD (a path equal to its committed version, e.g.
264	        a deterministic record written again, is not staged by git and is left out) and push (testgate.commit_paths;
265	        the preconditions were checked before they were written: precommit()). Returns the commit, or None when
266	        nothing changed. Smoke: nothing is committed."""
267	        if not self.mode.formal:
268	            return None
269	        rels = [self.rel(x) for x in paths]
270	        changed = [r for r in rels if TG._blob(self.root, "HEAD:%s" % r) != (self.root / r).read_bytes()]
271	        head = TG.commit_paths(self.root, changed, message, what) if changed else None
272	        for x in paths:                             # after a successful commit (or nothing to commit) only
273	            if x in self.uncommitted:
274	                self.uncommitted.remove(x)
275	        if head is None:
276	            self.log("%s: equal to the committed version, nothing to commit" % what)
277	        else:
278	            self.log("committed and pushed %s: %s" % (what, head))
279	        return head

286	    def stop_check(self, fn, *args):
287	        """Run a stop check. Formal: a stop propagates. Smoke: a stop of SMOKE_RECORDED_STOPS is recorded as

312	    def start_checks(self, command):
313	        """Continuity of a formal pilot (module docstring): once a formal run committed step records, a --work
314	        without the device ledger is refused (ST9 and ST7 read it); formal refuses to run again once a freeze record
315	        is committed. Raises a BLOCKED stop before anything is written."""
316	        if not self.mode.formal:
317	            return
318	        if TG._blob(self.root, "HEAD:%s" % STEP1_RECORD_REL) is not None and not self.ledger.path.exists():
319	            raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "a formal run has committed step records (%s) but --work %s holds no "
320	                               "device ledger: either this is not that run's --work, or that run stopped before its "
321	                               "first model load (step 2); a restart is the Owner's decision" % (
322	                                   STEP1_RECORD_REL, self.work))
323	        if command == "formal" and TG._blob(self.root, "HEAD:%s" % R.SELECTION_FREEZE_REL) is not None:
324	            raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "a freeze record is committed (%s): Gate 0 passed and the "
325	                               "configurations are frozen; formal is not run again" % R.SELECTION_FREEZE_REL)
326	        if command == "formal" and self.ckpt_dir.is_dir() and any(self.ckpt_dir.glob("*.pt")):
327	            raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "--work %s already holds checkpoints of a formal run: each run is "
328	                               "trained once; a restart is the Owner's decision" % self.work)

330	    def run_seconds(self, spec):
331	        """ST7 look-ahead of a training run: the base model loaded, the preflight's per-step time x the contract's
332	        steps (x the A factor for arm A only, as B17), the checkpoint hashed, saved, file-hashed, reloaded and hashed,
333	        one DEV evaluation (0 before the preflight)."""
334	        if self.pre is None:
335	            return 0.0
336	        q = self.pre
337	        factor = q["a_factor"] if spec.arm == "A" else 1.0
338	        return (q["load_s"] + q["mean_step_s"] * self.contract.training.total_steps * factor + 2 * q["hash_s"]
339	                + q["save_s"] + q["file_hash_s"] + q["reload_s"] + q["dev_evaluation_seconds"])
340	
341	    def eval_seconds(self, load):
342	        """ST7 look-ahead of one DEV evaluation (0 before the preflight); `load`: "load" (the base model loaded
343	        first), "reload" (a checkpoint loaded first, load_checkpoint) or None (the model is in memory)."""
344	        if self.pre is None:
345	            return 0.0
346	        return {"load": self.pre["load_s"], "reload": self.pre["reload_s"], None: 0.0}[load] + \
347	            self.pre["dev_evaluation_seconds"]

349	    def step_start(self, k):
350	        """ST12 before every step (Implementation Task Order V1 section 5): PROTOCOL_FROZEN, the four frozen files,
351	        and from step 2 on the inputs and the whole data directory (data.verify). ST13 by detection
352	        (stops.st13_scan): no TEST file in the data or TEST directory before the freeze record is committed."""
353	        self.fz = STP.st12(self.root, self.inputs, self.data_dir if k > 1 else None)
354	        STP.st13_scan(self.fz, self.root, [self.data_dir, self.work / TEST_DIR])
355	        self.precommit("the step %d record" % k)
356	        self.step1_started = True
357	        if torch.device(self.device).type == "cuda":
358	            torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
359	        self.steps[k] = {"step": k, "started_utc": utc(), "t0": time.perf_counter(), "files": []}
360	        self.log("step %d: ST12 passed%s" % (k, " (frozen files)" if k == 1 else " (frozen files, inputs, data)"))
361	
362	    def step_end(self, k, record, paths=(), message=None):
363	        """The step's record (seconds, peak memory, files written) under the records directory; formal: committed with
364	        `paths` and pushed."""
365	        st = self.steps[k]
366	        st["seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - st.pop("t0")
367	        st["peak_memory_bytes"] = CP.peak_memory_bytes(self.device)
368	        st["peak_memory_kind"] = ("CUDA max_memory_allocated of the step" if torch.device(self.device).type == "cuda"
369	                                  else "peak resident set size of the process so far (CPU)")
370	        files = [str(x) for x in paths] + [str(x) for x in record.pop("_files", [])]
371	        st["files"] = sorted(set(files))
372	        rec_path = self.write("step%d_record.json" % k, dict(record, step_info=st, kind="step%d" % k))
373	        self.commit(list(paths) + [rec_path], message or "metrix: E1-PILOT formal step %d record" % k,
374	                    "the step %d record" % k)
375	        self.log("step %d done in %.1f s" % (k, st["seconds"]))
376	        return rec_path

395	    def first_load(self):
396	        """Right before the first model load of this command (called by before_run and base_model): records the
397	        device name at the pilot's first load (section 7) and opens a GPU clock segment (a segment left open by a
398	        process that died is closed first, counted up to now). No CUDA device: ST8."""
399	        if not self.mode.formal or self.clock_opened:

443	        structure; state_sha256 again, equal or IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL. Returns (reloaded model, checkpoint info)."""

461	                "file_sha256": FZ.file_sha256(path), "file_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
462	                "seconds": {"hash": t1 - t0, "save": t2 - t1, "reload": t3 - t2, "hash_after_reload": t4 - t3}}

497	def check_model_dir(fz, model_dir, weights):
498	    """ST12 for the model: config.json (and, with `weights`, every *.safetensors file and at least one) in model_dir
499	    was downloaded from the frozen revision (DATA_MANIFEST.json model.revision): the first line of the
500	    huggingface_hub download metadata of each file is that commit. Returns {file: sha256} of the weight files."""
501	    rev = fz.data_manifest["model"]["revision"]
502	    d = Path(model_dir)
503	    names = ["config.json"] + (sorted(p.name for p in d.glob("*.safetensors")) if weights else [])
504	    if weights and len(names) == 1:
505	        raise ST12Error("no *.safetensors weight file in %s (run_pilot.py fetch-model)" % d)
506	    out = {}
507	    for n in names:
508	        meta = d / ".cache" / "huggingface" / "download" / ("%s.metadata" % n)
509	        try:
510	            got = meta.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")[0].strip()
511	        except OSError as e:
512	            raise ST12Error("%s: no download metadata %s (%r)" % (n, meta, e)) from e
513	        if got != rev:
514	            raise ST12Error("%s in %s was downloaded from revision %r, the frozen revision is %s" % (n, d, got, rev))
515	        if n != "config.json":
516	            out[n] = FZ.file_sha256(d / n)
517	    return out

584	def preflight(p):
585	    """Section 8 step 2 (ST11; B17 plus the checkpoint overhead, see the module docstring): the first configuration
586	    for the protocol's preflight steps (formal: preflight mode on the A100; smoke: smoke mode on the CPU, its numbers
587	    are smoke values). Its outputs are timing only."""
588	    pmode = M.preflight_mode(p.contract) if p.mode.formal else p.mode
589	    spec = T.search_runs(p.contract, "F")[0]
590	    p.before_run()
591	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
592	    model = p.base_model()

594	    try:
595	        res = T.train_run(model, p.tok, p.rows, spec, p.contract, pmode, p.device)
596	        summ = CP.preflight_summary(res.log, p.device)
597	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
598	        E.evaluate_model(model, p.tok, p.rows, p.fz.templates, p.contract.evaluation, pmode, p.device, split="dev")
599	        eval_s = time.perf_counter() - t0

601	        STP.st6(p.fz, e.values or [float("nan")], "preflight %s: %s" % (spec.name, e), True)
602	        raise

604	    T.state_sha256(model)
605	    hash_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
606	    d = p.work / PREFLIGHT_DIR

608	    path = d / "preflight_checkpoint.pt"
609	    t0 = time.perf_counter()

611	    save_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
612	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
613	    FZ.file_sha256(path)
614	    file_hash_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
615	    del model

618	    fresh = p.base_model()

620	    reload_s = time.perf_counter() - t0

625	    anchor_per_step = sum(sum(len(anchors[i]) for i in T.anchor_docs(s, p.contract.arms)) for s in steps) / len(steps)
626	    fact_per_step = sum(e["fact_tokens"] for e in res.log) / len(res.log)
627	    used = p.clock.used() if p.clock is not None else 0.0
628	    hours, parts = CP.estimate_total_hours(p.contract, summ["mean_seconds_per_step_excluding_first"], fact_per_step,
629	                                           anchor_per_step, eval_s, used)
630	    overhead, counts = checkpoint_overhead_seconds(p.contract, load_s, hash_s, save_s, reload_s, file_hash_s)
631	    p.pre = {"mean_step_s": summ["mean_seconds_per_step_excluding_first"], "a_factor": parts["a_factor"],
632	             "dev_evaluation_seconds": eval_s, "load_s": load_s, "hash_s": hash_s, "save_s": save_s,
633	             "reload_s": reload_s, "file_hash_s": file_hash_s}
634	    out = {"label": pmode.label, "mode": pmode.name, "run": spec.name, "steps": res.steps_run, "summary": summ,
635	           "dev_evaluation_seconds": eval_s, "fact_tokens_per_step": fact_per_step,
636	           "anchor_tokens_per_step": anchor_per_step, "b17_estimate_hours": hours, "b17_parts": parts,
637	           "st11_reads": "b17_estimate_hours", "st11_bound_hours": p.contract.stops.st11_hours,

640	           "timing": p.pre, "checkpoint_file": str(path), "_files": [path]}
641	    p.log("preflight (%s): %.4f s/step, DEV evaluation %.1f s, B17 estimate %.3f h (ST11); checkpoint overhead %.3f h "
642	          "(report only; sum %.3f h)" % (pmode.name, p.pre["mean_step_s"], eval_s, hours, overhead / 3600.0,
643	                                        hours + overhead / 3600.0))
644	    return out

685	def train_and_evaluate(p, spec, n_general, selected_or_control):
686	    """One training run (protocol sections 4, 7) and the DEV evaluation of its saved final checkpoint. A non-finite
687	    value (ST6): outside the selected configurations and the controls the configuration is excluded from selection
688	    (returns a result with finite False); otherwise IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL (the stop propagates)."""
689	    p.before_run(p.run_seconds(spec))
690	    model = p.base_model()                              # train.train_run sets up the arm (LoRA for L)
691	    rec = {"kind": "training_run", "run": spec.name, "arm": spec.arm, "config_id": spec.config_id,
692	           "config": spec.cfg, "seed": spec.seed, "phase": spec.phase, "device_name": p.device_name}
693	    ck = None
694	    try:
695	        res = T.train_run(model, p.tok, p.rows, spec, p.contract, p.mode, p.device)
696	        params_forward = sum(q.numel() for q in model.parameters())
697	        reloaded, ck = p.save_checkpoint(spec, model)
698	        del model
699	        model = None
700	        p.before_run(p.eval_seconds(None))
701	        ev = p.evaluate(reloaded, with_em=True, with_s_mapping=spec.arm == "S")
702	    except T.NonFinite as e:
703	        try:
704	            STP.st6(p.fz, e.values or [float("nan")], "%s: %s" % (spec.name, e), selected_or_control)
705	        except STP.Stop as stop:
706	            if not stop.exclude_config:
707	                raise
708	            if ck is None:                  # stopped in training: the state at the stop is the run's final state
709	                _, ck = p.save_checkpoint(spec, model)
710	            p.excluded.append({"run": spec.name, "reason": str(stop)})
711	            p.log("ST6: %s excluded from selection: %s" % (spec.name, stop))
712	            rec.update(finite=False, excluded=str(stop), checkpoint=ck)
713	            return {"spec": spec, "finite": False, "state_sha256": ck["state_sha256"],
714	                    "record": p.write("%s/%s.json" % (RUNS_DIR, spec.name), rec)}
715	        raise ImplementationFail("non-finite values %r without a stop" % (e.values,))
716	    summ = p.summary(ev)
717	    dnll, ppl = S.dnll(ev["general_dev"], n_general)
718	    rec.update(finite=True, steps_run=res.steps_run, contract_steps=p.contract.training.total_steps,
719	               mode_steps=p.mode.steps(p.contract.training.total_steps), trainable=res.trainable,
720	               frozen_sha256_before=res.frozen_sha256_before, frozen_sha256_after=res.frozen_sha256_after,
721	               base_trainable=res.base_trainable, notes=res.notes, log=res.log,
722	               accounting=CP.run_flops(p.contract, res, params_forward), checkpoint=ck,
723	               dev=_summary_record(summ), dnll=dnll, ppl_degradation_pct=ppl)
724	    run_path = p.write("%s/%s.json" % (RUNS_DIR, spec.name), rec)
725	    det = p.write(DETAILS_DIR + "/%s_dev.json" % spec.name, {"kind": "evaluation_details", "model": spec.name, "split": "dev",
726	                                                       "evaluation": ev})
727	    del reloaded
728	    gc.collect()
729	    if torch.device(p.device).type == "cuda":
730	        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
731	    p.log("%s: %d steps, acc_dev_learned %.4f acc_cb %.4f dNLL %.5f, state sha256 %s (unchanged after reload)" % (
732	        spec.name, res.steps_run, float(summ["acc_dev_learned"]), float(summ["acc_cb"]), dnll, ck["state_sha256"][:16]))
733	    return {"spec": spec, "finite": True, "ev": ev, "summary": summ, "dnll": dnll, "state_sha256": ck["state_sha256"],
734	            "record": run_path, "details": det}

796	def step7(p, runs, n, leakage, selected):
797	    """Section 8 step 7: G0.8 re-evaluation of F's selected configuration (each of the 3 checkpoints reloaded and
798	    evaluated a second time), Gate 0 G0.1-G0.10, the section 6 comparisons (reported). Formal: the Gate 0 record is
799	    committed; ST4 / ST5 when G0.7 / G0.6 do not hold."""
800	    p.step_start(7)
801	    seeds = p.contract.training.training_seeds
802	    repro, files = {}, []
803	    for seed in seeds:
804	        spec = runs[_name("F", selected["F"], seed)]["spec"]
805	        p.before_run(p.eval_seconds("reload"))
806	        model = p.load_checkpoint(spec, p.ckpt_dir / ("%s.pt" % spec.name))
807	        ev2 = control_evaluation(p, model, "G0.8 second evaluation of %s" % spec.name, with_em=False)
808	        del model
809	        gc.collect()
810	        repro[seed] = (runs[spec.name]["ev"], ev2)
811	        files.append(p.write(DETAILS_DIR + "/%s_dev_g08.json" % spec.name, {"kind": "evaluation_details", "model": spec.name,
812	                                                                     "split": "dev", "evaluation": ev2,
813	                                                                     "purpose": "G0.8 second evaluation"}))
814	    # G0.2 reads the values used: a non-finite value in a used run (N, a selected configuration, S, Y, the G0.8
815	    # re-evaluations) stops the pilot with ST6 before this point; configurations excluded by ST6 during the search
816	    # (section 7: "出现非有限损失或分数的配置剔除") are not used and are listed in the step 7 record ("excluded"). How G0.2
817	    # reads an excluded configuration is for Review Gate (reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md).
818	    inp = {"leakage": leakage, "all_finite": True, "nonfinite": [], "facts": p.rows["facts.jsonl"], "N": n["summary"],
819	           "repro": repro}
820	    for arm in ("F", "L", "A"):
821	        inp[arm] = {s: runs[_name(arm, selected[arm], s)]["summary"] for s in seeds}
822	    for arm in p.contract.arms.inheriting:
823	        inp[arm] = {s: runs[_name(arm, selected["F"], s)]["summary"] for s in seeds}
824	    values = G.compute_values(inp, p.contract)
825	    judged = G.judge(values, p.contract, p.mode)
826	    comparisons = G.report_comparisons(inp, p.contract, "dev")
827	    s_mapping = {s: {k: inp["S"][s][k] for k in ("s_mapping_dev_learned", "s_mapping_cb")} for s in seeds}
828	    g0_path = p.write(R.GATE0_RECORD, R.gate0_record(p.fz, p.mode, judged))
829	    p.log("Gate 0: %s %s" % (judged["gate0_status"], judged.get("reasons") or judged.get("note") or ""))
830	    rec = {"values": values, "gate0": judged, "comparisons": comparisons, "s_own_mapping": s_mapping,
831	           "excluded": p.excluded, "smoke_stops": p.smoke_stops}
832	    p.step_end(7, rec, [g0_path] + files, "metrix: E1-PILOT formal step 7 (Gate 0 record)")
833	    sat = {c: judged["conditions"][c]["satisfied"] for c in G.CONDITIONS}
834	    p.stop_check(STP.st4, p.fz, sat["G0.7"])
835	    p.stop_check(STP.st5, p.fz, sat["G0.6"])

857	def step8_smoke_refusal(p):
858	    """Smoke, step 8 (Implementation Task Order V1 sections 6 item 9 and 7): the TEST generator, run as run_pilot runs
859	    it (test_generate_command), refuses: RESULT: FAIL, non-zero exit, its --out not created; no TEST file anywhere
860	    under <work>."""
861	    p.step_start(8)
862	    out = p.work / "step8_refused_out"
863	    if out.exists():
864	        raise ImplementationFail("%s exists before the refusal test" % out)
865	    formal = [rel for rel in (R.GATE0_RECORD_REL, R.SELECTION_FREEZE_REL, TG.ST10_RECORD_REL)
866	              if TG._blob(p.root, "HEAD:%s" % rel) is not None or (p.root / rel).exists()]
867	    if formal:                          # there the generator's preconditions may hold: it would generate TEST
868	        raise ImplementationFail("smoke step 8 refused: this checkout holds formal records %s; the refusal test runs "
869	                                 "only where no Gate 0, freeze or ST10 record exists" % formal)
870	    r = subprocess.run(test_generate_command(p, out), cwd=str(p.root), capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
871	                       env=_subprocess_env())
872	    lines = (r.stdout or "").strip().split("\n")
873	    test_files = sorted(str(x) for n in D.TEST_FILES for x in p.work.rglob(n))
874	    refused = r.returncode != 0 and lines[-1:] == ["RESULT: FAIL"] and not out.exists() and not test_files
875	    rec = {"command": test_generate_command(p, out), "returncode": r.returncode, "stdout": r.stdout,
876	           "stderr": r.stderr, "out_exists": out.exists(), "test_files_under_work": test_files, "refused": refused}
877	    p.log("step 8 (smoke): TEST generator exit %d, last line %r, --out created %s, TEST files %s" % (
878	        r.returncode, lines[-1:], out.exists(), test_files))
879	    p.step_end(8, rec)
880	    if not refused:
881	        raise ImplementationFail("the TEST generator did not refuse in smoke mode")
882	    return rec

1002	def run_gate(p, command):
1003	    """The command formal or smoke: steps 1-7 (+ the step 8 part), then the experiment record (also for a stopped
1004	    or crashed run). Returns (completed without a stop, Gate 0 status or the stop's status)."""
1005	    crash, gate0 = None, None
1006	    try:
1007	        p.device_info_record = p.device_check()
1008	        if p.mode.formal:                           # the records name the code that ran (testgate.code_commit)
1009	            p.code_commit = TG.code_commit(p.root)
1010	            p.start_checks(command)
1011	        status, actual, nxt, _ = gate_steps(p)
1012	        gate0 = actual["gate0"]["gate0_status"]
1013	        stop = None

1016	        actual, nxt = stopped_actual(p, e), "report to the Owner (stop %s)" % (e.stop,)
1017	        stop = {"code": e.stop, "status": e.status, "message": str(e), "void_pilot": getattr(e, "void_pilot", False)}
1018	        p.log("STOP: %s" % e)
1019	    except Exception as e:           # a crash: the record is written (section 10: stopped runs too), then re-raised
1020	        crash = e                    # (NOT_TESTED: the word for a crash is for Review Gate, reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md)
1021	        status, actual, nxt = "NOT_TESTED", stopped_actual(p, e), "report to the Owner (the run crashed)"
1022	        stop = {"code": None, "status": None, "message": "crash: %r" % (e,)}

1024	        p.close_clock()
1025	    final_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, p.runs, stop)
1026	    if p.mode.smoke:
1027	        report = smoke_report(p, p.runs, actual)
1028	        p.write("smoke_report.json", report)
1029	        print_smoke_report(p, report)

1042	def final_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop):
1043	    """Write the experiment record; formal: commit and push it. A failing commit or push leaves it in the working
1044	    tree (reported; the Owner decides) and is re-raised only when the run itself did not stop.
1045	    A formal run that stopped before step 1 began (the device check ST8, the code not committed, the commit
1046	    preconditions of step 1) did not start on this machine: its record is written to <work>, outside the repository,
1047	    and nothing is committed (no formal command writes into or pushes from a clone on a machine that is not the
1048	    pilot's); the operator reports it with the log (RUNBOOK_A100.md section 4). This includes ST8 on the A100 host
1049	    (e.g. a 40 GB card), ST12 or ST13 at the start of step 1, the continuity checks (start_checks), and ST12 in
1050	    Pilot() itself (no Pilot, so no record at all: run_pilot.py exits with the traceback). Whether such a record
1051	    belongs in the repository is for Review Gate (protocol section 10; reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md).
1052	    Records written by the run and not yet committed (a stop or crash inside a step) are committed with it."""
1053	    if p.mode.formal and command == "formal" and not p.step1_started:
1054	        paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop, outside_repo=True)
1055	        p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s; the run stopped before step 1: not committed)" % (paths[0], status))
1056	        return paths
1057	    paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop)
1058	    p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s)" % (paths[0], status))
1059	    try:
1060	        p.precommit("the experiment record")
1061	        left = [x for x in p.uncommitted if x not in paths]
1062	        p.commit(left + paths, "metrix: E1-PILOT formal %s experiment record (status %s)%s" % (
1063	            command, status, "; %d records of the stopped step" % len(left) if left else ""), "the experiment record")
1064	    except ProtocolStop as e:
1065	        p.log("the experiment record was not committed: %s; it stays in the working tree; report to the Owner" % e)
1066	        if stop is None:
1067	            raise
1068	    return paths

1114	    (its committed ST10 record has a count over its frozen limit), the stop is a protocol stop of the pilot: the

1251	    without a stop code (a precondition of the generator, the continuity checks, a committed record or a file, the
1252	    checkout and commit preconditions in begin) leaves no experiment record: nothing was evaluated; a protocol stop
1253	    (ST7 look-ahead, ST8, ST9, ST10, ST12) gets one. TestAlreadyEvaluated (TEST was evaluated by an earlier run) writes
1254	    nothing and is raised: the pilot's status is the one of its result. Once this process began the evaluation, the
1255	    experiment record (BLOCKED for a stop or a crash, KeyboardInterrupt included) is written and committed whatever
1256	    happens; the exception is raised again. Returns (completed without a stop, final status or the stop's status)."""

1259	    try:

1261	        nxt, stop = "Owner and Review Gate read the TEST result (an E1-V1 protocol only after PASS)", None
1262	    except (ProtocolStop, TD.PreconditionFailed) as e:

1265	        begun = begun_by_this_process(p)

1269	        status = getattr(e, "status", None) or "BLOCKED"

226	def check_commit_preconditions(repo_root, what):
227	    """C1 ruling 2: before a record (`what`: the ST10 record, the TEST marker, the TEST result) is written, the
228	    pilot's checkout (check_checkout), nothing staged, a committer identity and `git push --dry-run` accepted. Any
229	    failure is BLOCKED and nothing is written."""

234	    if _git(root, "var", "GIT_COMMITTER_IDENT").returncode != 0:
235	        raise _blocked("no git committer identity (user.name, user.email)")
236	    dry = _git(root, "push", "--dry-run", "--no-follow-tags", PILOT_REMOTE, "HEAD:refs/heads/%s" % PILOT_BRANCH)

241	def _push(root, retries, sleep, what):
242	    """Push HEAD to PILOT_REMOTE PILOT_BRANCH (a plain push: fast-forward only; --no-follow-tags) and check the remote
243	    ref; retried `retries` times with 2, 4, 8, ... s pauses (`sleep`, time.sleep when None). BLOCKED when the remote
244	    ref is not HEAD at the end."""
245	    sleep = time.sleep if sleep is None else sleep
246	    head = _git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
247	    last = ""
248	    for i in range(retries):
249	        r = _git(root, "push", "--no-follow-tags", PILOT_REMOTE, "HEAD:refs/heads/%s" % PILOT_BRANCH)
250	        ls = _git(root, "ls-remote", PILOT_REMOTE, "refs/heads/%s" % PILOT_BRANCH)
251	        if r.returncode == 0 and ls.returncode == 0 and ls.stdout.split()[:1] == [head]:
252	            return head
253	        last = (r.stderr + ls.stderr).strip()
254	        if i + 1 < retries:
255	            sleep(2 ** (i + 1))
256	    raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", scrub("%s is committed (%s) but was not pushed to %s %s (%s); report to the "
257	                                              "Owner" % (what, head, PILOT_REMOTE, PILOT_BRANCH, last)))

260	def commit_paths(repo_root, rels, message, what, retries=4, sleep=None):
261	    """Commit exactly the repository paths `rels` and push them (the caller checked check_commit_preconditions before
262	    it wrote them): refused (BLOCKED) when anything is staged before; `git add --` of those paths only; the staged
263	    paths must be exactly them; commit; push and remote-ref check (_push). A staging, commit or push failure is
264	    BLOCKED (report to the Owner). Returns the commit."""
265	    root = Path(repo_root)
266	    if _git(root, "diff", "--cached", "--quiet").returncode != 0:
267	        raise _blocked("the git index holds staged changes; the commit of %s holds its own paths only" % what)
268	    add = _git(root, "add", "--", *rels)
269	    staged = sorted(_git(root, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only").stdout.split())
270	    if add.returncode != 0 or staged != sorted(rels):
271	        raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", scrub("staging %s failed (%s; staged %s, expected %s); report to the "
272	                                                  "Owner" % (what, add.stderr.strip(), staged, sorted(rels))))
273	    c = _git(root, "commit", "-q", "-m", message)
274	    if c.returncode != 0:
275	        raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", scrub("committing %s failed (%s); report to the Owner" % (
276	            what, (c.stdout + c.stderr).strip())))
277	    return _push(root, retries, sleep, what)
